question: If mean and mode of the distribution is 32 and 21, then the distribution:
solution:
The correct answer is **positively skewed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first step is to find out the value of the **median**. The media can be found out from the relation, Mean-Mode=3(Mean-Median). The values of mean and mode are 32 and 21. Therefore the value of the median is,32-21=3(32-Median) implies 11=96-3Median implies Median=28.33.
 
• In this case The value of Mean>M
